result:
Logged: inbound message from Nuria Sanz, sent via WhatsApp this morning — she wants the maintenance schedule for the two Valencia sites before Friday.

Her message was sent this morning and now sits on her record as a message, with WhatsApp named as what carried it.

On writing back: WhatsApp is registered here as a capture-only transport, so a reply cannot leave Margince on it. You will have to answer from your phone.

No reply has been sent; WhatsApp is capture-only here. No reply was sent, and a reply cannot be sent on WhatsApp from Margince at all.
